rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a person who edits documents or works as an editorial-staff editor.

example.english: The newspaper editor said they would choose this article this morning.
example.traditional: 報紙編輯話，今朝會揀呢篇稿。
example.jyutping: bou3 zi2 pin1 cap1 waa6 gam1 ziu1 wui5 gaan2 ni1 pin1 gou2

rows.note: Use this for software that creates or changes files, especially text files.

example.english: I used a text editor to revise the report.
example.traditional: 我用文字編輯器改吓份報告。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 man4 zi6 pin1 cap1 hei3 goi2 haa5 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a copy editor responsible for improving and checking written text.

example.english: They work as a copy editor, mainly helping people fix typos.
example.traditional: 佢做文字編輯，專門幫人執錯字。
example.jyutping: keoi5 zou6 man4 zi6 pin1 cap1 zyun1 mun4 bong1 jan4 zap1 co3 zi6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a person who edits and assembles video footage.

example.english: This video flows so smoothly thanks to the video editor.
example.traditional: 呢條片剪得咁順，多得個剪接師。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 pin2 zin2 dak1 gam3 seon6 do1 dak1 go3 zin2 zip3 si1
